title: Blockheads mod index (index.json)
description: Built by the Blockheads-Club/mods CI from every entry file and served over HTTPS at https://blockheads.club/mods/index.json. The file is not signed: integrity comes from the `sha256` and `size` of every package version, which consumers (game, Patcher, website, server) must check before installing a package. Entries are sorted by id, versions in publication order.

api.description: blockheads:api versions the index CI checked against.
